fields.description: JSON object: ticker, companyName, industry, dataAsOf date, fiscal period, and HTTPS source URLs with source notes.
fields.label: Identity and source packet

fields.description: JSON object: market snapshot (price, asOf, currency, pe, marketCapUsd, sharesOutstanding), three fiscal years of revenue/net income/FCF, balanceSheet (cash, debt, equity, NWC, netPPE, shares), and unknowns.
fields.label: Standard financial and valuation packet

fields.description: JSON object: business model, moat, management, capital allocation, risks, contrary evidence and unknowns; every fact keeps its original wording, HTTPS source, date and sourceTier (S/A/B/C).
fields.label: Business quality and risk evidence packet

fields.description: JSON object: explicit bear/base/bull DCF drivers — years, revenue growth, EBIT margin, tax, D&A, capex, NWC, interest, debt repayment, WACC, terminal method/value. Missing drivers block the model; no defaults.
fields.label: Model assumptions (bear / base / bull)

fields.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD freshness reference for the 7-day price and 45-day identity checks. Blank falls back to modelAssumptions.asOf, then the run date.
fields.label: As-of date (optional)

instructions: One US equity per row. Supply the three packets plus modelAssumptions; asOf is optional.

Every quotable fact must stay an atomic field. References must use full paths such as financialPacket.marketSnapshot.pe or qualitativePacket.moatEvidence[0].fact; shorthand like pe or annualHistory.revenue is not allowed.

Missing financials, mismatched periods, unclear sources, or company self-reporting that has not been independently verified must be written explicitly to unknowns or a limitation note. No guessing. Keep GAAP and adjusted figures separate.

The cloud runs a deterministic preflight gate first. If ready=false, the four reviews and the model step are skipped and no model fees are incurred for them. The local program still performs the final evidence audit and model recomputation.

Price judgment must bind to marketSnapshot price and timestamp, and to identityPacket fiscal period. Without a historical valuation range or normalized owner earnings, the row must NOT be marked margin of safety sufficient.
A model value is conditional arithmetic on the supplied assumptions; it is not a target price, return forecast, or buy/sell instruction.
